title: Learning to evolve by matching velocities
summary: The study compares simulation-free velocity matching with trajectory-based learning objectives on selected ODE and PDE systems. It reports that discretization and trajectory fitting can create spurious learned equilibria; the target equations are known, so this is a methods result rather than discovery of new natural dynamics.
ai_technology: Neural networks trained by velocity matching; trajectory-fitting objectives
organization: Not stated in the abstract reviewed

evidence.tested: Mathematical analysis and simulations on selected known ODE/PDE systems compare the learned velocity fields and equilibrium behavior.
evidence.unknown: Evidence concerns the equations and discretization settings studied; it does not establish new physical dynamics.
